study_question: Does a single LightGBM classifier, trained walk-forward on the same production engineered features and ternary labels as Study #4, clear the same MCC advancement screen on SPY/QQQ/IWM x {1c,5c,15c,60c}?

explicitly_not.not_xgb_stack_twin: One tree challenger only; does not permanently add a second booster beside XGB.

model.name: lightgbm.LGBMClassifier
model.no_hyperparameter_search: frozen; changing after seeing results invalidates the run

primary_metric.name: MCC (multiclass Matthews correlation, Gorodkin)
advancement_screen_per_cell: day-block bootstrap 95% CI of MCC excludes 0 (B=1000)
Holm-Bonferroni adjusted bootstrap p < 0.05 across 12 cells
accuracy >= always_flat AND majority_class AND persistence

baselines.majority_class: predict previous-row truth majority helper via stats.baseline_accuracies
baselines.elastic_net_reference: Study #4 cell MCC on same screen is context only
